scope.title: Browser source / session-ownership / side-effect boundary ledger
scope.source: policy unit verification + source wiring pin (no live browser/account)

decision.reason: Existing browser provenance tests (42) pass; new ledger guard pins the coverage: external-access applies to every action, session-ownership gate only to click/type. evaluate/command/close are recorded as residual. No SSRF/private-network/kill-switch change.

sessionOwnershipGate.requires: Main-owned managed session under external/unknown provenance

residual.evaluateCommandClose: Side-effecting actions evaluate / command / close are not covered by the click/type session-ownership gate; they only pass the connection-mode gate. Recorded as residual, not claimed covered.
residual.scope: agent_browser tool egress only; renderer/other browser entry points are out of scope.
residual.noNetworkRuleChange: SSRF / private-network / kill switch rules are independent and unchanged.

independentVerification.detail: The guard resolves both policies across provenance x connection-mode matrices and pins the tool wiring (external-access before invoke; session gate only on click/type). No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: external/derived-untrusted/missing/invalid provenance is denied auto-connect/cdp/external-profile; managed allowed; trusted system/operator unrestricted.
click/type under external/unknown provenance require a Main-owned managed session; otherwise denied.
Every action recorded; only click/type carry the extra session-ownership gate.
evaluate/command/close recorded as residual (side-effecting but not session-gated); no over-claim.
SSRF/private-network/kill switch untouched; no third policy introduced.
42 existing + 5 new tests pass, typecheck:test 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.

notMeasured: A separate second-agent independent verifier role.

landing.note: Pushed with the evidence commit in the same session; see the branch's PR.
